descriptions: I am the main protagonist of my series.
I love eating Miso Chashu Ramen at Ichiraku.
I have a nine-tailed beast sealed inside of me.
My dream is to become the Hokage.
My signature jutsu is the Rasengan.
I am the last remaining loyal member of the Uchiha clan at the start.
I seek vengeance against my older brother.
My eye power is the Sharingan.
I walked away from the village to gain power from Orochimaru.
My primary lightning-style jutsu is Chidori.
I am known as the Copy Ninja.
I always wear a mask covering my mouth and left eye.
I love reading 'Make-Out Paradise' books.
I was the leader of Team 7.
I became the Sixth Hokage.
I am the true mastermind of the entire shinobi world.
I defeated Madara Uchiha in one hit.
I served ramen to every major villain and hero without getting scratched.
I hold the legendary Sage of Six Bowls title.
I am the owner of Ichiraku Ramen.
I am the most powerful creature in the Naruto universe.
I can speak human language and run at extreme speeds.
I have escaped from Team 7 multiple times.
I am an animal ninja wearing a headband.
I am a martial-arts-using ninja ostrich.
I am the kunoichi with excellent medical ninjutsu.
I trained under Lady Tsunade.
I have pink hair and green eyes.
I am part of Team 7.
My signature technique is the Hundred Healings Mark.
I am a legendary Sannin known as the Toad Sage.
I wrote the Make-Out series of books.
I taught the Fourth Hokage.
I have white spiky hair and wear a forehead protector with 'Oil' kanji.
I died fighting Pain in the Hidden Rain Village.
I am the genius of the Hyuga clan.
I have the Byakugan eye ability.
I am shy and admire Naruto deeply.
My fighting style is Gentle Fist.
I eventually marry Naruto and become the mother of Boruto.
I am the strongest creature in existence.
I can summon meteors with a single hand gesture.
I possess the legendary Rinnegan in both eyes from birth.
I defeated all five Kage simultaneously without breaking a sweat.
I am Sakura's pet goldfish that she named after Sasuke.
I possess the most powerful jutsu in all of shinobi history.
My technique can instantly defeat any opponent regardless of their power.
I used this ability to defeat Kaguya Otsutsuki.
My jutsu is called 'Talk no Jutsu'.
I am the main character who talks villains into becoming good guys.
I am the most feared weapon in the ninja world.
I have taken down countless enemies without mercy.
My existence terrifies even the strongest shinobi.
I am wielded by Rock Lee and might break your bones.
I am a pair of green spandex training weights.
